violations.why: irq_delta's v_sable++ is a read-modify-write. The higher-priority irq_ridge can preempt it and write v_sable at line 196 between the read and the write-back. That write is lost.
irq_umbra reads v_coral twice, at lines 149 and 150. The higher-priority irq_inlet can preempt it between the reads and write v_coral at line 183, so the two reads can see different values.
irq_umbra reads v_onyx twice, at lines 151 and 152. The higher-priority irq_raptor can preempt it between the reads and write v_onyx at line 190, so the two reads can see different values.
